explanation: Fill a reservoir with the first k stream values. For each later value at position i, draw a uniform index among all i+1 seen positions and replace that reservoir slot only when the index is below k.
timeComplexity: O(n) sampling time; the supplied wrapper performs repeated statistical trials.
spaceComplexity: O(k) reservoir/output space, excluding the wrapper’s statistical samples.
